name: Chopped on the Guidebook
desc: Left hand side of the cave, overhanging line on super jugs. Crosses over the anchor of 'Baba Max' and finishes on the anchor with 'Smoked Out'. 12 slings.

name: Baba Max
desc: Green threads up the left side of the cave. Climbs out onto the free hanging stalactite. 7 slings.

name: Dude Abides
desc: Shares the start with 'Smoked Out' and Round the Outside, then to the left up the slab to the green anchor in the cave. 3 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Rope to start route core exposed

name: Smoked Out
desc: Shares the start with 'Dude Abides', then right and straight up. Go all the way to the right to climb 'Round the Outside'. 5 titanium bolts, 3 slings, 1 fixed extended clip.

name: Round the Outside
desc: Shares the first half with 'Smoked Out' and Dude Abides, then traverses to the anchor of 'Chong Phli Posse'. 1 titanium bolt, 5 slings.

name: Chong Phli Posse
desc: Shares the anchor with 'Round the Outside'. Gives access to the following three upper pitches. 1 titanium bolt, 3 slings. 1st pitch of Fin de Chalam, Flying Snake and Stone Rider.

name: Fin de Chalam
desc: The left-most extension of 'Chong Phli Posse'. 31m from the ground. 3 titanium bolts, 7 slings. Share start with Flying Snake and Stone Rider.

name: Flying Snake
desc: The middle extension of either 'Round the Outside' or 'Chong Phli Posse'. Shares the start with 'Stone Rider' and Fin de Chalam, then straight up. 29m to the ground. 6 slings.

name: Stone Rider
desc: The right-most extension of either 'Round the Outside' or 'Chong Phli Posse'. Shares the start with 'Flying Snake' and Fin de Chalam, then veers right. 31m to the ground. 3 titanium bolts, 4 slings.
warnings: Fixed Gear: Anchor carabiner opens very hard

name: Eminem
desc: His palms are sweaty, knees weak, arms are heavy...

name: Shady
desc: Short with a steep start. 5 titanium bolts.

name: Slim / Slim Shady
desc: Right of 'Shady', purple slings and titanium bolts. 3D climbing through the bottom overhang onto the big fin. 2 titanium bolts, 6 slings.

name: Yellow Moon / Tim's Big Smile
desc: Starts just right of 'Slim', through the roof on the right side of the feature and up into the stem corner. 9 blue slings.

name: Make it Funky
desc: Right of 'Yellow Moon', 4m left of 'Music Wall'. Climbs through a steep bulge to a green anchor. 3 bolts, 6 slings.

name: A Pinch Tu-far
desc: Steep face, with thin tufa, short and spicy 🔥

name: Cave Racer
desc: The start is just before you walk up the stepping stones to the main crag, half way up the small hill on top of the boulder. Shares the start with "Dean the Machine" then cuts left about 3 bolts up

name: Dean the Machine
desc: The start is just before you walk up the stepping stones to the main crag, half way up the small hill on top of the boulder. Shares start with "Cave Racer"

name: The General
desc: Shares the start with Alpha Male. Goes a bit left of the second clip then follows the left side of the arete.

name: Alpha Male
desc: At the top of the stepping stones. behind a small tree. It climbs up the right side of the arete. Shares start with The General but heads right after second clip.

name: Luna Cruise
desc: 2 bolts, 11 slings

name: Send Train
desc: 4 bolts, 4 slings, then continues to the share the anchor of Luna Cruise.

name: Fixe
desc: Right of Send train. Boulder style start.

name: Doctor Zeus
desc: 7 titanium bolts.

name: French Blow
desc: Extension of Doctor Zeus, positive crimps, into jug rails, with epic heal hooks. Super good moves!

name: Athena
desc: 5 titanium bolts.

name: Aphrodite
desc: 6 titanium bolts.

name: Frankenstein - Open Project
desc: Epic climbing! Absolute Classic! Please try, open project! 8c or 8c+. 14 titanium bolts.

name: monkey trail
desc: 1 3 20m 2 5b 25m 3 5b 30m 4 5c 25m Nice multipitch to the top of the mountain, 100m away from Machete Wall, if you reach the starting point, accent 20m to the first pitch, first part secured by fix rope, 1. pitch 25m, two slings, then travers 15m (fix rope, one sling), 2. pitch 30m, 3 slings, traverse 10m left, fix rope, 3. pitch 3 slings, starting at the big cave to the right, from there you can just reach the top of the mountain (hiking), descending back the same way.

name: Walking on the Moon
desc: Directly through the lefthand corner. Slopers, smears and pockets.

name: Steal Your Face
desc: Just right of 'Walking on the Moon'. Start up the blunt arete, then climb up the left enduring face. 6 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

name: Into the Mystic
desc: 2nd pitch after Steal your face, climbing up and right through the gulley, reaching right on small feet. Continue up to the top, over the tuffa roof and cruising through the juggy top section. Amazing view, access to mountain top possible. Climb "Steal your Face" and "Into the Mystic" in one go with an 80m rope.

name: Hell in a Bucket
desc: Short but fun climb up onto the big ledge. Gives access to 'Soulshine', 'Imagine' and 'Dark Star'. Great climb for beginners/guiding. 4 slings.

name: Soulshine
desc: Lefthand line on the big ledge, up along a thin crack. Starts on the sling left below the anchor of 'Hell in a Bucket'. 25m from the ground. 5 titanium bolts, 3 slings, 1 fixed draw at the crux.

name: Imagine
desc: The middle line starting from the big ledge. Accessed by climbing 'Hell in a Bucket'. Shares the first 2 slings with 'Dark Star', then left up a white streak, following the yellow slings. 25m from the ground. 3 titanium bolts, 5 slings, 1 fixed draw.

name: Dark Star
desc: The righthand line starting from the big ledge accessed by 'Hell in a Bucket'. Shares the first two clips with 'Imagine', then right along the blue threads. 25m from the ground. 8 slings.

name: Big Underwear / Dobolina
desc: The right hand start from the ground. Climbs better than it looks. Intermediate anchor on the ledge for beginners/giuding, or skip and continue up to the tree. All slings.

name: Shoes
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Ain't Nobody Got Time
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Lord Jesus
desc: Shares the start with 'There's a Fire', then up the left bolt line. All titanium bolts.

name: There's a Fire
desc: Same start as 'Lord Jesus', then up the right bolt line. All titanium bolts.

name: Bronchitis
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Cold Pop
desc: All titanium bolts.

name: Lady Bug
desc: Beautiful tufa climbing, great route for kids or first time leading. 3 slings + titanium anchor.

name: POP / Pussy on Pedestal
desc: 2 titanium bolts, 2 slings. Bolted 2013?

name: Pac Man
desc: Left traversing route, really fun climbing, and friendly bolting.

name: Moby-Dick
desc: Beautiful moves through the epic roof with BIG jugs! Shares anchor with Beached Whale.

name: Captain Ahab
desc: Extension of Moby-Dick, stay left and proud through the roof, finishes at top of wall.

name: Beached Whale
desc: Bouldery start, with big jugs, upto beached whale ledge leads to beautiful moves on pocketed face/tufa(crux), traverse up and left to anchor. Stick clip 1st bolt if at your limit! 6 Titanium bolts, 1 sling (6/10/24)

name: Beached Whale - Extension
desc: Continue on past Beached Whale anchor to the top of the wall. Shares anchor with Captain Ahab.

name: Sling Shot
desc: Starts on Beached Whale, goes right at 2nd clip.

name: Roaring Kitty
desc: Short, bouldery, epic slopper-slapping, glory-jug at anchor! Recommend stick clip 1st bolt and a belayer who can belay properly. (History; Single tope-rope bolt added in 2013 by Mike and friends, retro-bolted for lead in 2024, by DnD).

name: Via Ferrata
desc: Where is this route ?

name: Liam 'The Birdman' Byrne
desc: Probably one of the steepest routes of its grade in Thailand. Super fun climbing mostly on big holds. Stick-clip the first bolt.

name: Red Herring
desc: Start on Piranha, at ledge take left hand line to finish. Shares anchor with Piranha.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Piranha
desc: Shares the first three clips with 'Red Herring'. Then right and back to the same anchor. 8 titanium bolts, 1 sling. Share anchor with Buzzsaw (Lefthand Variation).
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Predator
desc: Extension to Piranha. Beautiful dynamic face climbing leads to a tricky transition onto an amazing European-style tufa with slopes, crimps, and a long sustained crux sequence with no rest. Absolute classic !!
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Hidden Gem
desc: Red fixed draws (left of Buzzsaw). Really lovely climb with beautiful movement! Continue in a straight line on to slab above, links into Buzzsaw, finish on green anchor.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Buzzsaw
desc: Same start as Seesaw, up the black slab, take LEFT hand line to finish. Shares anchors with Seesaw.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Seesaw
desc: Same start as Buzzsaw, then climb RIGHT hand line, up thin technical slab to finish. Shares anchor with Buzzsaw.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Tetris
desc: Extension above Buzzsaw/Seesaw. Super rad! Crimpy fun!
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Spirit Mountain
desc: Super super super classic, start on brown ladder, finish on the pedestal ledge.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Foot Prints
desc: Right of ladder, overhanging start, then up slab, finish on pedestal ledge.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Finding Nemo
desc: First route to the right of Foot Prints. Starts up blocky face/arete for 5 bolts, then re-join Foot Prints up slab to pedestal and anchor finish.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Hook, Line, Sinker
desc: Starts right of the boulder. Unique climbing with a technical ending on an arete. 10 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Slab Royal
desc: Start up 'Hook Line Sinker' arete, pull the lip to anchor and head left up orange slab! Can climb with 70m rope, 1 pitch.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Kan Bet Tok Pla / Fishing Rod
desc: Extension, Hook, Line, Sinker - 2nd pitch. Absolutely SUPERB climbing on orange stalactites, takes you almost to the top of the wall! Can climb as one pitch from ground, (80 metre rope), or can climb as two pitches (60 metre rope). Ti bolts and slings. Ti anchor ring 22/4/23
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Rampage
desc: Start up Hook Line and Sinker arete, one clip before anchor, traverse right through big roof, mantel outside lip/hole to finish - anchor on right side arete.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Burleigh But Sensitive
desc: Start on Finding Nemo, continue up arete (Hook Line and Sinker), at 3rd bolt on arete traverse right on vertical white face, and into juggy roof - Shares anchor with Rampage. Has some fixed draws but not all: bring two of your own.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: KGB Extreme
desc: Cool start up bulge thing, over ledge and into a hard white slab-overhang, finishing up superb corner to anchor. Absolute classic moves in the crux !!
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Deflowered
desc: 7 titanium bolts, 7 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Momentum
desc: Second line on the huge tufa system. Anchor right next to 'Deflowered'. Maybe stick-clip the first sling. 14 titanium bolts, 2 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: McLovin
desc: 10 titanium bolts, 3 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: EFZ / Ego Free Zone
desc: Shares the first half with 'Family Affair', then straight up to the left lower anchor. 3 bolts, 10 slings. TI Anchor ring (2022)
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Family Affair (1st pitch)
desc: Shares the start with 'EFZ', then right and up to the higher anchor.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Family Affair (2nd pitch)
desc: Family Affair extension, 1 sling, 4 bolts, + anchor. 80 metre rope can lower back to ground, put a knot on the end to be safe.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Family Affair (3rd pitch)
desc: Can climb all in one 55 metre pitch from ground. Lower down to Family Affair anchor, and re-tie your rope, to reach ground. Make sure to put a knot in the end of your rope, to avoid being lowered off the end. Alternatively, can climb multi pitch style, belay at top of 2nd pitch.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Zac Attack
desc: Shares anchors with 'Mad Skills'. 7 titanium bolts, 1 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Mad Skills
desc: Shares anchors with 'Zac Attack'. 5 titanium bolts, 2 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Mantally iII / Mentally Ill
desc: 7 titanium bolts, 4 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Mantally Ill P1 / Mentally Ill P1
desc: Easier variation to the intermediate anchor. Nowadays there isn't a real anchor point to pass the rope through to back to the ground, just a two bolts. Shares the finish with '8ish P1'.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: 8ish
desc: All TI bolts.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: 8ish P1
desc: Easier variation to the intermediate anchor. Nowadays there isn't a real anchor point to pass the rope through to back to the ground, just a two bolts. Shares the finish with 'Mantally Ill P1'.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Carbunkle / Carbuncle
desc: Shares the start with 'Round the Bend', then left. 6 titanium bolts, 2 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Round the Bend
desc: Shares the start with Carbunkle, then right. 8 titanium bolts, 4 slings.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Bell Curve
desc: Follows a normal distribution, up and right to the anchor.
sector: The Ego Free Zone / Main face

name: Hopeful Parents
desc: Furthest left route, located about 15 meters left of the main area. Climb up the stellar tufa, and finish to the left under the roof

name: Gargoyle Socks
desc: Starts left of the small cave. Stay left of the big tree, and climb through the roof.

name: We’ll Eat Like Kings
desc: Start left of the bigger cave. Continue up and stay right of the big tree.

name: The Real Reason Dinosaurs Became Extinct
desc: Start right of the bigger cave.

name: Early Experiments in Transportation
desc: Might be dirty in upper part after rain

name: Jumanji
desc: Fun climb up vine, best to climb barefoot. Slings and titanium anchor.

name: Baby Foot
desc: Short line starting on tufas at the very left up the small hill. All titanium bolts.

name: Hello Kitty
desc: Tricky rock over at 1st bolt (crux), followed by nice jugs to anchor.

name: Schmoopy Power
desc: Starts just left of 'Babies in the Sky'. All TI bolts.

name: Babies in the Sky
desc: This route originally finished after 15m at the anchor of 'Mainlander' which would be a good option if the upper section is wet after rain. Now it continues up on black rock to it's own anchor at 28m. Possibly you need about 15 quickdraws, but I need to check.

name: Mainlander
desc: Shares the anchor with 'Babies in the Sky'. All titanium bolts.

name: Rex Kwan-Do
desc: All titanium bolts. Two TI bolts with SS rings for anchor.

name: Singa-Paw
desc: Extension of Rex Kwan-Do, similar style to Slap and Tickle.

name: Singa-Paw Slap!
desc: Climb Singa-Paw and mantle the final ledge to standing, then traverse into Slap & Tickle. Keep going for the Slap!

name: Superstition
desc: All TI bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Slap and Tickle
desc: Second pitch of 'Superstition'. All TI bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Man
desc: Great rock, technical crux up high. Share start with Mouse. All TI bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Mouse
desc: Same start as 'Man', but traverses right to a big hole just before the 8th clip. From the hole continue to left anchors. All TI bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Kaeng Raeng
desc: Shares the start with 'Pill Box', then left after the first sling. All TI bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Middle Path
desc: Extension of 'Kaeng Raeng'. All TI bolts. 70m rope required. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: J-dog
desc: Start same as Kaeng Raeng, head right at 3rd bolt, to crimpy corner/dihedral.

name: Pill Box
desc: Shares the start with 'Kaeng Raeng', then right after the first sling. Finishes on the anchor slightly to the left. All TI bolts.

name: Red Planet
desc: Second pitch of 'Pill Box'. 5 titanium bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Mars Attacks (Red Planet Ext).
desc: Open Project, maybe 8c/+? please try. 80m is rope fine, tie knot in end.

name: Scorpion
desc: Climb 'Pill Box' to the last bolt, then go right and up. Two bolts before the anchor, take the left lines into the huecos. One hold has been "enhanced" (drilled) to make it more homogeneous. All TI bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Scorpion (Direct)
desc: Same climb as 'Scorpion', just don't use the manufactured four finger pocket.

name: Scorpion Queen 🦂
desc: OPEN PROJECT, 8B+/8c??? Same start Scorpion, continue on 2nd pitch, Scorpion extension 🦂 70m rope, tie a knot in the end.

name: Ice-9
desc: Climb 'Scorpion', but take the right of the two bolt lines on the 3rd last clip. One hold has been "enhanced" (drilled) to make it more homogeneous. All TI bolts.

name: Ice-9 (Direct)
desc: Same climb as 'Ice-9', just don't use manufactured four finger pocket.

name: Chasing Windmills
desc: To the right of Pillbox.

name: Exfoliation
desc: The leftmost line, starting from the boulder. Tricky technical line. All titanium bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Exposure
desc: Extension of 'Exfoliation'. 4 titanium bolts, Go left just before the anchor.

name: Exposure (Direct)
desc: Right-hand variation at the top section of 'Exposure'. Shares the same anchor. Go straight up before the last bolt of 'Exposure'. Harder for short reaches. 4 titanium bolts extension.

name: Snow Leopard
desc: Spectacular moves following thin orange tufa fin up head wall! Mega-classic! Start up Exfoliation/Exposure, head left before anchor, (alternate start from Scorpion/ICE 9). 70m rope okay, Tie a knot. F.A. KDennis on the last day of his trip and coinciding with his birthday 🎈🥳🎉

name: I Am Ironman / Ironman
desc: Extension above "Exposure".

name: Iron Blast
desc: Climb Ironman and link into Free Blast.

name: Hobbit Hop
desc: Starts on the boulder, just right of 'Exfoliation'. All TI bolts.

name: Hobbit Jump
desc: Extension of 'Hobbit Hop'. All TI bolts.

name: Free Blast
desc: Climb Hobbit Jump, after anchor, head left across face to crack flack. 80 metre rope gets you back to the ground.

name: Alien
desc: Extension of 'Hobbit Hop' and 'Hobbit Jump', all the way up the thin black tufa. 8 titanium bolts. TI Anchor ring (2022)

name: Simon Sends
desc: Short easy slab just right of the boulder. All TI bolts.

name: Sticky Rice
desc: 1st climb left of Chutzpah. Start up slab, clip bolt to the right of the anchor "Simon Sends", then straight up orange slopes to anchor. All TI bolts.

name: Chutzpah
desc: Straight up the grey tufa streak. All TI bolts.

name: Trippin'
desc: 4 titanium bolts, 5 slings.

name: Hunting Shrooms
desc: Shares the start with 'Grace', then left after the 4th bolt. All TI bolts. Share anchor with Trippin'.

name: Scarface
desc: Extension of either 'Trippin' or 'Hunting Shrooms'. All TI bolts.

name: Kingpin
desc: Lefthand extension of Scarface. All TI bolts. Shares the anchor with Right Hand Man.

name: Sumo King
desc: The extension to Kingpin. This climb goes to the top. All Titanium Bolts

name: Right Hand Man
desc: Righthand extension of Scarface. All TI bolts. Shares the the anchor with Kingpin.

name: Grace
desc: Shares the start with 'Hunting Shrooms', then right after the 4th bolt. All TI bolts. Share anchor with Renegades of Funk.

name: Baby White Tiger
desc: Climb start Scarface, at the 5th bolt traverse right and up the slab. All titanium Bolts.

name: White Tiger (Direct)
desc: Start up Grace, move left before anchor up overhang. All titanium bolts.

name: White Lion
desc: Same start as "Grace". After anchor head up overhang. All titanium bolts.

name: Renegades of Funk
desc: Start right-side platform. Up slab, then right on bulge. Share anchor with Grace. All TI bolts.

name: Rage Against The Machine
desc: Next route right of Renegades of Funk. Start off platform. All Ti bolts.

name: Wild Child
desc: Grade not confirmed. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: Old School
desc: 3 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

name: RTT / Rubber Tapping Tranny
desc: Grade confirmed by fedor and tim: https://www.8a.nu/crags/sportclimbing/thailand/chong-phli/sectors/wild-child-wall/routes/rtt-rubber-tapping-tranny

name: Indi'Jan'a Jones
desc: Must-do climb. Maybe a bit harder. All titanium bolts.
